_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the environments this harness can target. Read by src/env.mjs
(the MCP server), bin/ft-e2e-run.mjs (the CLI) AND harness/lib/config.cjs (playwright.config.ts,
the fixtures and every harness script) -- nothing else carries its own list.
Fintary has one web app (services/web, Vite + React, Firebase Auth) and one main API
(services/api, Next.js API routes under /api). The API reads `authentication: Bearer <Firebase ID
`wired` says whether a test RUN is allowed there. preview and prod are declared with their real
origins so preflight can probe them (GET /api/healthcheck, /manifest.json), but they are NOT wired:
preview runs on the shared fintary-prod AlloyDB and fintary-prod Firebase Auth, so a write on
preview is a write to production data. Every test context also aborts non-GET calls to both APIs.
dev and uat share the fintary-dev Firebase Auth pool, so one test user can sign in to both;
uat has its own database, so that user also needs rows there.

environments.name: local
environments.label: Local stack
environments.notes: Web :3001 (services/web `pnpm dev-local`, fintary-dev Firebase) + API :3000 (services/api `pnpm dev-local`) + Postgres :5431 (docker local-psql). scripts/agent/up.sh (dev_stack_up) runs web and API on the auth emulator :4002 and seeds <seeded-admin-email>: sign in with E2E_EMULATOR=1 + E2E_UID=<seeded-admin-uid>. Never the :5432 proxy: that is production.

environments.name: dev
environments.label: Dev
environments.notes: Shared, deployed on every push to main (deploy-dev.yml). preflight reports the API's commitSha (/api/healthcheck) and the web build time (/manifest.json versionInfo.buildTime). Write cases (@writes) only on accounts named 'E2E Test account…' and data prefixed E2E_.

environments.name: uat
environments.label: UAT
environments.notes: Manual deploys only (deploy-uat.yml, ref must be on main). Same Firebase Auth pool as dev, its own database.

environments.name: preview
environments.label: Preview
environments.notes: Declared, not wired. Shared PRODUCTION database and fintary-prod Auth: reachability and live-commit checks only.

environments.name: prod
environments.label: Production
environments.notes: Declared, not wired. Live customer data: reachability and live-commit checks only. Every test context aborts non-GET calls to api.fintary.com.
